connector.name: BorealHost
connector.registryDescription: Agent-native web hosting - deploy sites, manage DNS, register domains, scale infrastructure
connector.summary: Hosted at borealhost.ai over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the Python package borealhost-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace ai.borealhost, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: BOREALHOST_API_KEY
env.description: BorealHost API key (format: bh_<48 hex chars>). Optional — you can also call register() or set_api_key() at runtime.
